justifications.reuse: the change reuses the owners rather than forking them: decide_batch (imas_codex/discovery/base/judgment.py:230) owns concurrency/budget/retries, gather_classification_context (:815) owns the path context, and imas_standard_names.grammar.tags.get_physics_domain_description owns the scope sentences; the only new definition, build_domain_questions, composes those and matches the repo's established inline choice-question idiom (judge_stage.py:140 _form_questions, imas_codex/discovery/paths/scorer.py:251), for which no shared builder exists.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff stays inside the declared write paths except tests/graph/test_dd_domain_classifier.py and tests/core/test_settings.py (git diff --stat against 6b5f1d573), both outside the fence and both disclosed in the manifest's fence_exceptions as necessary to keep the brief's named gate files green.
